Jordan (CS): Heads up – Nimbus spike in token usage this week, QBR next Thu. Need a short rundown of current burn, onboarding blockers, and a recommended mitigation plan. Who can pull numbers and help prep slides? :eyes:
Priya (FinOps): I can pull spend breakdown and forecast. Will need last 14 days and token mix (chat vs embeddings). ETA 2h.
Sam (Solutions): I'll check if they've enabled embeddings-heavy pipelines in staging. Can we get the eval prompt set they're using?
analytics-bot: usage-snapshot for account=nimbus: 2026-03-20..2026-03-22 total_tokens=1,245,678; embeddings=68%; chat=32%; peak/hour=150k tokens/hr
Olivia (CS): Onboarding note: Nimbus paused session rehydration last week due to KV cache bug; engineering deployed patch Monday but they reported degraded quality afterwards.
Jordan (CS): @Olivia can you capture the exact rehydration steps + current success rate? Need to tie to token spend.
Olivia (CS): Yep. Patch rollout PR: https://git.redwood/repo/kv-rehydrate/pull/421
Olivia (CS): Current success rate ~87% (was 95% pre-change). I'll put a quick runbook blurb in the QBR doc.
Priya (FinOps): Quick ask: can someone share the per-route token rates? I want to model mitigation impact of turning on prefix caching vs throttling.
Sam (Solutions): Per-route: /chat: 0.6 tokens/op avg, /embed: 2048 tokens/op (heavy) — will export CSV in 30m.
Nora (Enablement): I can do a 10-slide enablement snippet for Nimbus's team with best practices: batching, embeddings size caps, and local cache hints. Draft tomorrow morning.
Liam (AE): FYI customer is in renewal conversation; they want a savings plan before commit. Can we propose a dedicated capacity estimate and expected % savings?
Priya (FinOps): I'll run two sims: (1) prefix caching + embeddings quantization -> projected -38% unit cost; (2) dedicated reserved -> -52% cost but requires 3mo commit. Results by EOD.
Jordan (CS): Solid. For the QBR deck: bullets needed – current burn, root causes (rehydration + embedding churn), proposed mitigations (enable caching, embeddings cap, reserved), customer enablement actions, ask (commit/credits). I'll assemble slides after numbers land.
Sam (Solutions): CSV uploaded: /shared/nimbus/nimbus_route_breakdown_2026-03-22.csv
Olivia (CS): Captured blocker list and short customer quote in the doc: "We saw a cost shock when we turned on vectorized search" — will anonymize.
Jordan (CS): Thanks team. @analytics-bot can you snapshot the forecast model with Priya's sims once posted?
analytics-bot: scheduled_forecast job queued (job_id=ff3b2). Will post results thread update when complete.
Priya (FinOps): Forecasts queued. I'll attach a one-pager with the numbers to this thread.
Jordan (CS): Great. We'll do a 30m sync tomorrow 10:00am PT to finalize slides. Invite sent.
Liam (AE): Added meeting to Nimbus renewal cadence. I'll bring pricing options.
Olivia (CS): Added enablement checklist to QBR doc. :thumbsup:
Jordan (CS): End of thread.
